name: Down
baseline: Markdown.pl (the original Perl implementation); no Swift parser measured
verdict_reason: The README's numbers are upstream cmark's own C benchmarks against Markdown.pl, not a measurement of Down against any Swift default. Apple's swift-markdown, the usual Swift choice, is itself built on cmark-gfm, so the figures show no advantage over it.
tier_reason: Numbers quoted from cmark's README with no Swift-side measurement, hardware or version details.
claimed_speedup: cmark renders War and Peace in 127 milliseconds on a ten year old laptop; cmark is 10,000 times faster than Markdown.pl
workload: Rendering a Markdown version of War and Peace (cmark's benchmark, quoted in Down's README)
one_liner: Swift wrapper over cmark 0.29; its speed figures are cmark versus Markdown.pl and show no gain over Swift's cmark-based defaults.
how_it_is_fast: Parsing and rendering happen in the cmark C library (v0.29.0), which parses in linear time; the Swift layer converts the result to HTML, XML, LaTeX, groff, CommonMark or NSAttributedString.
use_it_when: You need its output formats (NSAttributedString, LaTeX, groff) from one call
skip_it_when: Choosing for speed: swift-markdown also parses with cmark (cmark-gfm)
You need GitHub-flavored Markdown tables or task lists: Down bundles plain cmark
You need maintained code: no commits since 2021
caveats: No measurement of Down itself; the numbers belong to cmark and compare it with a Perl script.
Bundles cmark v0.29.0, an old release.
tradeoffs: Old cmark (v0.29.0) without GitHub-flavored Markdown extensions

evidence.quote: can render a Markdown version of War and Peace in the blink of an eye (127 milliseconds on a ten year old laptop, vs. 100-400 milliseconds for an eye blink).
cmark is 10,000 times faster than the original Markdown.pl, and on par with the very fastest available Markdown processors.
Blazing fast Markdown (CommonMark) rendering in Swift, built upon [cmark v0.29.0]
The parser is powered by GitHub-flavored Markdown's [cmark-gfm](https://github.com/github/cmark-gfm) implementation
